_comment: Lane declarations for the fast path (world/server/fast_path.py).
A lane is a PIPELINE of stages, declared here and hot-reloaded on
file change. Stage vocabulary (audited code; JSON only composes):
observe:  http_get | vps_dispatch | price_spot
decide:   sma_band
act:      paper_fill | log
analyze:  llm
Unknown kinds and impossible compositions are rejected at build and
never run. LLM output is recorded as text, never executed.
DEFAULT STATE: every lane ships enabled=false -> the service is a
cheap silent watcher. Flip enabled=true to activate a lane; no
restart needed (hot-reloaded within ~10s).
Kill switch: touch data/fast-kill to pause every lane within a cycle.
BUG BOUNTY LANES RUN THEIR WORK ON A VPS, NEVER IN DOCKER AND NEVER
FROM THE HOME IP. Declare executor (host/user/port/key_path/
known_hosts) and pin the host key first:
ssh-keyscan -H <host> >> .secret_keys/fast_vps_known_hosts
The 'work' list is the ONLY thing the VPS will ever run. Missing or
unpinned executor config fails closed: the lane idles and says so.
MARKETS LANES ARE PAPER ONLY. No order-placement code path exists.
notional is per simulated trade in USD, hard-capped at 500 by env

pipeline.prompt: You are a bug bounty recon analyst. Work only within the declared scope. Be concise: list anything unusual worth a human look, or say "nothing notable".
You are a trading analyst on a PAPER trading lane. No real money. One short paragraph on price action and positions. Never give financial advice; this is system telemetry commentary.
